analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for 2 consecutive sessions. Current price at 38,875, above mid-term MAs (SMA20 37,722, EMA50 37,454) but below SMA100 (41,085). RSI at 55.5 in neutral territory, MACD histogram improvement slowing. ADX at 12.3 indicates a lack of trend formation.
